why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Tyler Stephenson is slot #2 (4.503 expected team runs/game).
Slots #2, #1, #3, #5, #4, #6, #7, #8 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #7 ranks 7 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.005 R/G.
Slot #2 yields 4.56 expected PA/game vs 4.02 at primary slot #7. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
